review: PR22 round1: D17 optional durability, provider startup, transcript content and error notices

entries.reason: Distinguish absent selected provider from unexpected runner errors without parsing exception text.
entries.contract: NoLLMProviderError selects Odin's exact unavailable-provider core notice; existing CapabilityUnavailable remains unchanged.
entries.invariant: Exception types grant no admission authority or effect replay.

entries.reason: Restore D17 legacy disabled turn handles and safe missing-ledger projections; explain pre-reply failures through core notices.
entries.contract: No startup ledger means uncheckpointed execution; a dead opened ledger refuses. Exceptions before a runner result produce bounded scrubbed notice text with request provenance.
entries.invariant: Task/owner/generation binding, queue deduplication, guarded model replies and no effect replay remain. Publication/accounting failure after a result cannot invent a contradictory execution notice.

entries.reason: Honor optional turn-state configuration and failed-open legacy mode; skip compatible client creation without a key instead of stopping the core.
entries.contract: D17 startup parity preserves Codex service when compatible credentials are absent; status exposes credential-free durability/provider reasons. Error accounting accepts absent turn ledger.
entries.invariant: Opened dead ledger never becomes legacy mid-runtime; real runner, native/executor policy, guards and budgets unchanged.

entries.reason: Expose optional durability and skipped compatible-provider diagnostics through real status.get and runtime.status.
entries.contract: Desktop users see durability off or unavailable and missing_api_key without reading journals.
entries.invariant: Diagnostics contain no credentials and do not grant execution or change authentication, shutdown or publication ordering.

entries.reason: Restore copied Odin store-is-None disabled handle under D17; retained Desktop gateway envelope stays otherwise inert.
entries.contract: Feature-off or failed-open legacy run has no blocked reason. An attached unavailable store still returns admission_error.
entries.invariant: Resumed leases, heartbeats, spent budgets, checkpoint fencing, prepared/running/result hooks and effect classification unchanged.

entries.reason: Remove Desktop-only refusal of an admitted legacy disabled durability handle under D17 while preserving the approved D18 conversation preamble.

entries.invariant: Request assertion, D18 preamble and all phase orchestration, guard/classifier/governor/budget bodies remain unchanged.
